response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software engineer, but his background is heavily focused on web technologies, TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang rather than C++. He lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of hands-on C++ development experience on Windows, having only a brief 7-month stint using C/C++ in 2014-2015. Additionally, while he has some exposure to capital investment firms, he does not possess the deep Capital Markets or Fixed Income domain expertise required, making him a poor fit for this specific role.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) across various modern stacks and architectures.
Strong background in CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and agile craftsmanship methodologies like TDD.
Has some exposure to the financial sector through his work reshaping investment practices at RIDE Capital.
concerns: Fundamentally lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of C++ development experience, with less than a year of professional C++ experience a decade ago.
No demonstrated experience with Windows-based enterprise C++ development; heavily leans toward Linux, Web, and Cloud.
Lacks the specific Capital Markets, Investment Banking, or Fixed Income domain expertise required.
